question: Can Q03 classify a geometrically matching STEP output by its construction provenance, so an input round-trip cannot be counted as B-Rep-to-CAD reconstruction?
model_class: generated CAD build scripts evaluated in the existing restricted STEP sandbox

required_facts: the generated build script and its execution trace
whether any executed dataflow reads the mounted original STEP, directly or through an imported helper/subprocess
whether output is produced when the original STEP mount is absent
existing executable, readability, bbox, volume, and topology outcomes
ambiguity_or_fail_closed_conditions: missing, incomplete, or unverifiable input-access trace
an execution policy that permits an unclassified read of the mounted original STEP
script cannot complete the absent-input control
a wrapper, helper, subprocess, or native call whose input provenance cannot be resolved

constrained_hypothesis: A result-classification gate plus an absent-input execution control can distinguish M44-style direct STEP round-trip from a build script that constructs its output independently. Geometry equality alone cannot make that distinction.

result_classes.round_trip: Executed script reads or derives output geometry from the mounted original STEP. Preserve current health-gate outcomes, but never count this class as reconstruction.
result_classes.independent_reconstruction: No executed dataflow can read the mounted original STEP, the script completes the absent-input control, and the existing health gates pass. This is provenance evidence only; it does not alone establish feature-history fidelity or editability.
result_classes.provenance_unknown: Any incomplete trace, unresolved indirect access, or failed/untested control. This class fails closed for reconstruction claims while retaining ordinary execution diagnostics.

evidence_precedence: verified executed input read overrides geometry success and yields round_trip
unresolved access or missing control yields provenance_unknown
only a no-read trace plus absent-input execution pass can yield independent_reconstruction
future_gate_or_diagnostic: record all runtime file-open attempts and executable-child provenance within the sandbox boundary
run an otherwise identical no-input-mount control after normal execution
retain M44's reader-to-writer script as a regression fixture classified round_trip
separate Q01 structured observation logs from the executed build-script filesystem capability
execution_and_repair.repair_disposition: diagnose_only; a repair may improve execution or geometry but cannot change a round_trip or provenance_unknown result into independent_reconstruction without a fresh normal run and control
stopping_rule: no hosted request under this design workpack
do not count current or historical geometry-only passes as reconstruction
if input-access tracing cannot cover helper/subprocess/native paths, classify provenance_unknown rather than weakening the rule
do not change sandbox mounts, prompts, gates, schemas, or reports without a separately selected G2 workpack and independent review

existing: M44 held-out case abc_v00_00000031 read /input/model.step through OCP, wrote output/model.step, and passed every executable/readability/bbox/volume/topology gate.
ADR-0047 classifies that result as STEP round-trip and execution compatibility, not reconstruction.
missing_counterexample: a future offline implementation showing that the trace covers all supported input-access routes
a valid independently constructed script passing both the normal run and absent-input control
evidence.next_minimal_experiment: Select one G2 offline implementation workpack to add provenance classification and an absent-input control against the fixed M44 regression. It must not send a provider request or broaden the CAD operation surface.

not_authorized: CAD helper, IR, or SDK change
